The dream closet!🥺 ❤️❤️❤️❤️

Dua Lipa gave fans a glimpse into her walk-in shoe closet, sharing a mirror selfie on Instagram that showed shelves stretching floor to ceiling packed entirely with footwear, a collection so large that overflow pairs were stacked on the floor as well. The photo came during a particularly eventful stretch, shared just before news broke that she'd married actor Callum Turner in a courthouse ceremony in London, where she wore a Schiaparelli suit paired with Christian Louboutin pumps. Among the styles spotted in the closet were a pair of Marc Jacobs Kiki boots, a design originally from the brand's fall 2016 runway known for its platform sole and distinctive buckle cutouts, along with a flame-patterned leather boot from Vetements.

Celebrity closet reveals like this one have become a recurring source of fascination online, offering fans a rare, unfiltered look at just how extensive a wardrobe can get at the highest level of fame. Dua Lipa has built a reputation over the years for her bold, ever-changing style both on and off stage, making moments like this one a natural extension of the fashion-forward persona she's cultivated throughout her career.

#DuaLipa #ShoeCloset #CelebrityStyle #Fashion #CelebrityHomes

@schiaparelli When Fashion Becomes Art ✨ at @vamuseum London ✨

An exhibition I’ve been longing to see for so long. As an artist myself, I felt an instant connection to Elsa Schiaparelli’s extraordinary imagination — where fashion, art, nature, the human form and emotion become one.

Every piece tells a story. From surreal silhouettes and playful details to Roseberry’s breathtaking contemporary creations, the exhibition reminded me that haute couture is not simply something we wear — it can provoke, inspire, surprise and become art.

What fascinated me most was Schiaparelli’s fearless creativity and sense of humour. Nothing was too unconventional, and every tiny detail had meaning.

Leaving the exhibition, I felt I had witnessed a true celebration of femininity, imagination and individuality.

Fashion isn’t always about following rules. Sometimes, it’s about creating your own world. ✨

The devil is in the detail. 🖤 #fashion #schiaparelli #fyp #london #viral
